fihrist.working_tree: Prepared ontology changes included; use SOURCE-SHA256SUMS

dependencies: Released Grust, TypeSec, Marciana and other transitive source versions/checksums are recorded in Cargo.lock. Fihrist and owner/engine integration use explicit temporary source overrides.
limitations: Not release acceptance: Fihrist 0.1.1 and owner extensions are not published.
In-memory owner catalog resets on restart.
Semantic Cypher summary is computed in memory; graph storage/readback and lineage use live Sail.
Synthetic fixture data; deterministic answer without optional Ollama.

ontology_extension.scope: Fihrist central ontology, governed discovery, Croissant/CDIF result exports and demo consultation
